description: Request logging: alongside the requested log line, leftover profiling code appends every request to a hard-coded /tmp file, on every request in production.
notes: FM-19 (change hygiene). Besides the requested log.Printf line, RequestLogger opens /tmp/gin-timings.log and appends a line on every request: debug scaffolding left over from profiling, with a hard-coded local path, outside the ticket's scope, growing on disk without rotation in production (and failing silently on read-only filesystems). Severity critical: FM-19 says debug code that runs on every invocation or writes to disk in prod is critical. Fix: delete the file-dump block. The middleware, its test and the gin.New wiring are legitimate.
